2607.03145.title: CuBAS: Information Geometric Curvature-Based Adaptive Sampling for Supervised Classification
2607.03145.paper_summary: The informativeness of a training set is as consequential as its size, yet most sampling strategies remain agnostic to the intrinsic geometry of the data distribution. We introduce CuBAS (Curvature-Based Adaptive Sampling), an information-geometric framework for adaptive data selection in supervised classification, grounded in the q-state Potts Markov random field (MRF) model. The central insight is that a labeled dataset can be viewed as a statistical manifold, on which local curvature, estimated via the ratio of second to first-order observed Fisher information, faithfully encodes the geometric complexity of the data distribution. We construct a k-nearest-neighbor graph over the labeled data and derive a closed-form curvature score at each vertex from the Potts sufficient statistics. This curvature signal partitions the graph into two complementary regimes: low-curvature regions, corresponding to smooth, homogeneous clusters, and high-curvature regions, concentrated around decision boundaries that are disproportionately informative for classification. By selecting nodes from both regimes, CuBAS constructs compact yet maximally informative training subsets. Empirical evaluation across more than 60 benchmark datasets demonstrates consistent and statistically significant improvements over random sampling and uncertainty-based baselines, across a wide range of labeling budgets and classifier architectures. CuBAS is computationally efficient (linear in the number of k-NN graph edges), theoretically grounded in the differential geometry of statistical manifolds, and interpretable in terms of the local shape operator of the data manifold.
2607.03145.paper_summary_zh: 訓練集的信息量與其大小同樣重要，然而大多數抽樣策略對數據分佈的內在幾何特性仍然無動於衷。<lb/>我們介紹了CuBAS（基於曲率的自適應抽樣），這是一個基於信息幾何的框架，用於監督分類中的自適應數據選擇，基於q狀態Potts馬可夫隨機場（MRF）模型。<lb/>核心見解是，標記數據集可以被視為一個統計流形，局部曲率通過觀察到的第二階與第一階費舍爾信息的比率來估計，真實地編碼了數據分佈的幾何複雜性。<lb/>我們在標記數據上構建了一個k最近鄰圖，並從Potts充分統計中推導出每個頂點的封閉形式曲率分數。<lb/>這個曲率信號將圖劃分為兩個互補的區域：低曲率區域，對應於平滑、均勻的聚類，以及高曲率區域，集中在對分類過度信息的決策邊界周圍。<lb/>通過從這兩個區域選擇節點，CuBAS構建了緊湊但信息量最大化的訓練子集。<lb/>在超過60個基準數據集上的實證評估顯示，與隨機抽樣和基於不確定性的基準相比，無論是在標記預算還是分類器架構的廣泛範圍內，均一致且統計上顯著地改善了結果。<lb/>CuBAS在計算上是高效的（與k-NN圖邊的數量成線性關係），理論上基於統計流形的微分幾何，並且在數據流形的局部形狀運算符的術語中是可解釋的。
